title: The Drowned Formula
story: In a secluded, old mansion on the outskirts of town, Dr. Ada Stone, a brilliant chemist specializing in rare toxins, was found drowned in her bathtub. Strange engravings were etched on the walls, depicting a mysterious formula. Surprisingly, the autopsy revealed no physical evidence of drowning, only traces of an extremely potent venom, 'Phantom Venom', in Dr. Stone's system.
victim: Dr. Ada Stone, a renowned Poisonologist
crimeScene: The lavish yet eerie mansion of Dr. Stone.
question: How did Dr. Ada Stone meet her demise, and who left those peculiar engravings on the walls?
options: Option A: The Phantom Venom (Suspicious lab accident and enigmatic notes)
Option B: The Illuminatus Society (Eerie engravings and a mysterious note)
Option C: The Rival Chemist (Angry rivalry and a cryptic message)
Option D: The Mansion's Enigmatic Tenant (Hidden motives and a code to decipher)
